source: Abu Dhabi referral options (from the project's support-options table). DRAFT: booking routes, costs and eligibility to be confirmed with each provider before a pilot. No wait times are shown until a provider confirms them.

services.name: SEHA primary care
services.cost: Check your insurance plan for cover and any co-payment.
services.about: Abu Dhabi's public family doctor and community clinics. Mental health screenings are part of primary care, and a family doctor can treat mild to moderate low mood or anxiety and look after physical health at the same time.
services.booking: Book an appointment at your nearest SEHA primary care clinic.

services.name: Pura app
services.cost: Check the app for prices and insurance cover.
services.about: An app from PureHealth, SEHA's parent company. Private online sessions with licensed psychologists and psychiatrists from SAKINA, plus guided meditations, educational content and resilience resources.
services.booking: Download the Pura app and book an online session.

services.name: SAKINA
services.cost: Check your insurance plan for cover.
services.about: SEHA's specialist mental health network: psychiatry, psychology, child and adolescent services, memory and elderly care, family support and community mental health.
services.booking: Contact SAKINA to book. In most cases no referral is required.
